title: After the Tenno Sho (Autumn): Blending Fragrance

text_block_list.name: Rose & Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I—!
*I* will—!

text_block_list.name: Rose & Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll win—!!
I'm going to winnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I... lost—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—gh!
...Ngh, how utterly pathetic...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaugh!!
Dammiiit—!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (...—Jordan.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not losing next time!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right now I might just be an 'almost there' Umamusume, but...!
...Ngh, that might be true, but still!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The one who's gonna hit it big is totally meeee!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... Such a tremendous thirst for victory—
even moments ago, your fiery passion made my heart tremble.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to offer you my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer. Forgive me, but
could you please fetch the cutlery?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gaaah, no way, no way! —Isn't that way too cliché?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you're thanking me?
Kinda late to ask, but did I even do anything like that?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The sight of you running in the race was dazzling.
You faced setbacks, and yet you rose again—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I saw myself in you.
...And it brought me relief.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: To think that rising again could be so radiant—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A... comeback?
choice_data_list: Seeing them rise up from hardship, perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's that even mean?!
Not really! That's totally normal!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like picking yourself back up when things don't work out.
Everybody's doing it, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For me... sure, there were definitely times
when things were rough, but...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I wanna do my best, and I wanna make my dream come true!
So like, duh, of course I'd do that much!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...—
Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Those days of hesitation, straying, and causing trouble... Through you, Jordan...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (It seems to have melted, if just a little, into my heart.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn)..."
It was a race from which something truly precious had been gained.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The path leading to the future is still long.
There may be times we falter once more.
Yet—even so, everything will surely be fine.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—The second leg of the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.
Our next race is the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup——
The battleground where, last year, she surpassed
the queen of the era, Buena Vista, and claimed victory.
choice_data_list: Many formidable rivals will gather once again this year.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
And for that very reason, let us make this a race that surpasses last year's.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
This autumn, the passion of the public has been ignited.
I shall etch the might of our Kingdom of the Rose into their minds, again and again.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And eternal tranquility.
—Together with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once more, toward the autumn international G1, the Japan Cup—
I want to climb to the summit and claim victory!
